appDescription: An apartment exploration app with contextual apartment scrap saving and synthetic test price summaries and briefings.

function.name: GET_AREA_PRICE_SUMMARY
function.description: Returns fictional synthetic test prices only, never real market prices. Named real areas are unsupported.

target.description: The source of the target area: the current vehicle location, an explicitly referenced earlier area, or a named area.

areaQuery.description: The name of the requested area when the target is NAMED_AREA.

function.name: SCRAP_APARTMENT
function.description: Saves the apartment currently selected in the app or offered in its visible scrap suggestion. Requests clarification when no target is available.

function.name: GET_REAL_ESTATE_BRIEFING
function.description: Returns three fictional test briefing items, never live news or housing announcements.
